name: @jadwigo/site
description: The marketing site at jadwigo.pl: Astro, static, Polish only for the hackathon

//.astro: builds the static site: pages, the content collection and the head tags (astro.config.mjs)
//.@astrojs/sitemap: writes sitemap-index.xml from the built pages
//.@astrojs/check: type-checks the .astro files in this package's typecheck script
//.@types/node: Node 24 types for this package's typecheck (tsconfig.base.json names them)
//.typescript: tsc for this package's typecheck script
//.vitest: runs this package's unit test with the root vitest.config.ts
//.@jadwigo/config: hosts.prod, the host this app serves (src/index.ts, astro.config.mjs)
//.@jadwigo/ui: the crown wordmark in the header and the Zeszyt tokens, foundation.css (src/layouts/Base.astro)
//.@fontsource/andika: Andika, the Zeszyt type every page is set in (src/layouts/Base.astro)
